title: Atomic Chat stable-diffusion.cpp Backends Manifest
description: Schema for the remote stable-diffusion.cpp (sd-server / sd-cli) prebuilt manifest consumed by Atomic Chat's diffusion installer. Unlike the llama.cpp manifest, every asset carries an explicit `backend` id: upstream asset names embed the CI runner's OS version (macOS-26.6.2, Ubuntu-24.04), so the client must never derive the platform from the file name.

upstream_repo.description: GitHub repository the tag was released from; the fallback CDN when download_base is absent.

tag_name.description: leejet/stable-diffusion.cpp release tag (e.g. master-849-d04e895). An `-a<sha>` suffix marks an Atomic-built variant carrying local patches; the client strips it when falling back to the upstream CDN.

download_base.description: Base URL the client prepends to '<tag_name>/<asset name>'. Present once .github/workflows/mirror-sdcpp.yml has re-signed and re-hosted the archives; absent means download from the upstream GitHub release.

backend.description: Stable backend id the client selects on; the only field it matches against.

companion.description: True for the Windows CUDA runtime archive that is unpacked next to the CUDA backend when the host has no CUDA toolkit.
